Jewel Master - Cradle of Rome.name: Jewel Master: Cradle of Rome
Jewel Master - Cradle of Rome.summary:
Build the heart of the Ancient Roman Empire and become its Emperor! This legendary city was one of the most beautiful and powerful capitals to have ever existed in the ancient world! Resurrect the masterpieces of Roman architecture. The Coliseum will make a good training school for your brave gladiators. And the Pantheon - the Temple of the Roman Gods - will bring you luck! The fabulous land of Caesar opens its gates before you in this engaging puzzle game, Cradle of Rome.

More than 20 masterpieces of Ancient Roman architecture to build.

Kuruma de DS.name: Kuruma de DS
Kuruma de DS.summary: A Japanese-only game for the Nintendo DS intended to be used during car rides. It connects to a Japanese GPS and is not playable without it. It uses Mii characters and has a built-in Mii maker.

Minna no Oekakiya-san.name: Minna no Oekakiya-san
Minna no Oekakiya-san.summary: A drawing game, developed and published by Taito.

Monster Jam - Path of Destruction.name: Monster Jam: Path of Destruction
Monster Jam - Path of Destruction.summary:
Monster Jam: Path of Destruction is a racing game based on the USHRA monster truck series

The game features 28 licensed Monster Jam trucks. Players can customise their own trucks with more than 1,000 parts, with eight real life stadiums from the Monster Jam circuit

In single player mode the goal is the same as for real life drivers - rise through the ranks of ruthless competitors to ultimately battle against the best at the Monster Jam World Finals! Also with heat to head multi play modes.

Onsei Kanjou Sokuteiki - Kokoro Scan.name: Onsei Kanjou Sokuteiki: Kokoro Scan
Onsei Kanjou Sokuteiki - Kokoro Scan.summary: While all games from Sega's Naruhodo edutainment series did not garner much mention, this game did. This is due to its bizarre premise and unique use of the Nintendo DS microphone picking up nuances in emotions of the voice. This technology was developed by SGI Japan.

Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of S.name: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky
Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of S.summary: Embark on a journey after you get turned into a Pokémon as a result of a freak accident, causing you to lose your memory as well as contact with and knowledge of your previous adventuring partner, with whom you were on a secret mission to save the world. Watch your story unfold in a dungeon crawling rogue-lite experience as you form your very own rescue team with a new partner of your choosing.

Smurfs 2, The.name: The Smurfs 2
Smurfs 2, The.summary: Relive The Smurfs 2 movie on Nintendo DS in this interactive storybook! Play mini-games inspired by key moments from the movie, alongside the storybook - like Clumsy Kung-Fu, Super Storks, and Smurf-a-pult!
